responsibility: Adds a simple target-macro override for Xilinx APU floating-point support. Its role is to redefine TARGET_XILINX_FPU in terms of the rs6000_xilinx_fpu target variable so backend code and patterns can test whether the Xilinx-specific auxiliary FPU option set is active.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem .md file, this header does not describe pipeline timing or instruction reservations; it only provides the C preprocessor-level target macro override that exposes the Xilinx FPU enable state to the rest of the rs6000 backend.
